items.text: Hey Explorers,

Patch 1.2 is now live! This update adds various new checkpoints, makes important levers, items and objects easier to spot & fixes various out of bounds & soft lock issues. We’ve also gone through all the chapters and done a scenery pass to improve performance and readability.
This patch requires shaders to be re-compiled upon startup.
Performance improvements across all chapters. In particular minimum and recommended spec PCs should see reduced FPS drops.
Added Additional checkpoints throughout the game.
Improved lighting across the game. The players attentions should be directed more towards important buttons, switches & objects.
Arabic text is now properly right-aligned across all text boxes.
Corrected missing Spanish, Ukrainian, and Russian user interface tags.
Better synchronized subtitles with Japanese and Chinese voice lines and fixed subtitle timing and legibility on white transition screens.
Fixed quiet voice lines in Portuguese and English, resolved overlapping audio lines during the ending cinematic.
Fixed an issue where very specific player positions could cause the player to change gravity directions in quick succession
Fixed setting changes not persisting across title relaunches.
Fixed low-res UI assets in the main menu.
Fixed camera/torso rotational desync where character torsos rotated twice as far as camera direction.
Fixed hooks remaining attached in mid-air or sticking to sliding glass doors.
Fixed hook rope snap behavior when players walk through hook lines and fixed hook breaking when shooting electricity plants.
Fixed persistent goopsuit slowdown effects when gooped before entering waking pods.
Fixed offsetted setdress colliders throughout all chapters
Fixed issues with the character getting stuck behind/in the environment models across the game.
Fixed a black loading screen issue caused after players having launched the game for a pre-release playtest.\\
Fixed walkie-talkie audio desync.
Fixed end credits auto-scrolling speed.
Fixed a bug where the credits checkpoint was not automatically selected when players party up after completing the game.
Chapter 1 - Fixed spawn orientation.
Chapter 1 - Improved VFX and animation on the rift in the opening sequence.
Chapter 2 - Fixed growth/shrink softlock caused by holding crouch while resizing.
Chapter 2 - Fixed block becoming stuck in the corner of Dahne’s Lab and fixed the bigger player collider snags.
Chapter 2 - Added outline shader to the computer chip model in Dahne’s lab for better clarity.
Chapter 2 - Fixed an issue where two music tracks would be playing in Dahne’s lab.
Chapter 2 - Improved 3D printer respawn fallback point in Dahne’s Lab to prevent lost progress on death.
Chapter 2 - Fixed stuck collision spot between table and couch that caused respawns back in waking room.
Chapter 2 - Readded some missing models in the common room.
Chapter 3 - Added new hidden checkpoints throughout the chapter to prevent punishing respawns.
Chapter 3 - Fixed issue with missing snow particles due to incorrect culling.
Chapter 3 - Fixed issues with respawning with incorrect gravity values troughout this chapter.
Chapter 3 - Spotlighted the door lever in Offices of Tomorrow with dedicated lighting to stand out.
Chapter 3 - Fixed status light above one of the doors in Offices of Tomorrow failing to update.
Chapter 3 - Fixed invisible walls near the desk area and patched out-of-bounds escape at hatch 50D in the Magnetic Stabilizer.
Chapter 3 - Polished Magnetic Stabilizer visuals and fixed parts of the stabilizer disappearing.
Chapter 3 - Fixed platform in Magnetic Stabilizer positioning errors when loading into high rift instability.
Chapter 3 - Fixed an issue where the animation of the particle accelerator rift could skip parts in transitions
Chapter 3 - Fixed an issue where a reward sound could be triggered multiple times at the Magnetic Stabalizer checkpoint.
Chapter 3 - Fixed that the rotating platform in the Magnetic Stabalizer would start at an incorrect position/rotation when starting at checkpoints in that area.
Chapter 3 - Fixed desync where platforms rotated without rotating standing players in the Gravitonics Department and added reverse rotation SFX.
Chapter 3 - Removed erroneous collider between rings 4 and 5 of the Gravitonics Department and fixed gravity resetting improperly upon respawn.
Chapter 3 - Fixed blue laser rendering behind windows instead of in front in Accelerator Targeting and adjusted lighting in dark corridors.
Chapter 3 - Fixed incorrect Chinese translation in the last room of the laser puzzle.
Chapter 3 - Synchronized nozzle animations with nozzle VFX in the Particle Accelerator Terminus.
Chapter 4 - Reordered generator UI objectives to match physical connection order and added monitors to help identify the batteries as the core objective.
Chapter 4 - Fixed cable feedback and clipping issues in the corridors of Routing Power.
Chapter 4 - Fixed players clipping through the vent after finishing Routing Power.
Chapter 4 - The generators now reset automatically for the next phase when the sequence entered is correct.
Chapter 4 - Improved visibility and pickup clarity for the cassette tape in Corporate Espionage. Also it is not required for progression to pickup the cassette tape.
Chapter 4 - Resolved clipping issues on inspectable documents and corrected dark lighting passes in Corporate Espionage.
Chapter 4 - Adjusted lighting in Routing Power for better cable and pathway readability.
Chapter 5 - Added new hidden checkpoints throughout the chapter to prevent punishing respawns.
Chapter 5 - Clarified puzzle symbols and monitor displays for the 2nd and 3rd symbol challenges in The TRC.
Chapter 5 - Eliminated softlocks where players could jump into The TRC main hall without a return path, and corrected collider sizing on vent H-06A.
Chapter 5 - Adjusted window glass shaders across multiple rooms to ensure glass panels are clearly visible.
Chapter 5 - Adjusted metallic surface definition in The TRC for better readability.
Chapter 5 - Added interaction push tooltips to the void crystals.
Chapter 5 - Fixed an issue where you could re-enter the utility closet area after completing it.
Chapter 5 - Added outline shader to the bridge projector at the Thieves of Time checkpoint for better clarity.
Chapter 5 - Fixed invisible walls and collision holes around the crystals and entrance posters.
Chapter 5 - Fixed mismatched floor panels, seams, and glowing oil textures.
Chapter 5 - Fixed player getting stuck behind the whiteboard and stair geometry in the greenhouse at the Overgrown checkpoint.
Chapter 5 - Fixed elevator falling deaths and lighting pops upon arriving at The TRC.
Chapter 5 - Corrected "You are here" indicators on the 2D map.
Chapter 5 - Fixed phantom clones being visible in the final cutscene of the Ghost of Our Past puzzle.
Chapter 5 - Adjusted lighting on doors in The TRC main hall for better visibility.
Chapter 6 - Adjusted dying sequences in this chapter to ensure proper timing and simultaneous player handling.
Chapter 7 - Fixed set dressing and seams across the chapter.
Chapter 7 - Fixed softlock on red membrane doors and eliminated membrane audio spam.
Chapter 7 - Removed player death and snag traps inside coral plants along Twisting Wall and Cave Maze.
Chapter 7 - Restored missing gravity-turning effects in floor tunnels in Theuthos Tunnels.
Chapter 7 - Fixed set dressing, lighting and puzzle flow fixes across all Testing Rooms in The Farpoint Outpost.
Chapter 7 - Fixed Testing Room 4 puzzle failing to recognize the correct solution and closed unintended puzzle skips.
Chapter 7 - Closed escape holes in Testing Room 3 & 4 boundaries.
Chapter 7 - Fixed an issue that caused the Anemone in Testing Room 4 to “bump” the player unintentionally when it moves
Chapter 7 - Fixed Macrophage respawning after the player dies and restored missing dissolve and burst audio.
Chapter 7 - Aligned energy flow particles and cables in The Farpoint Outpost.
Chapter 7 - Fixed animation states, materials and unresponsive audio for the plants in the Farpoint Outpost.
Chapter 7 - Fixed player divider collisions causing falling animation loops in The Fate of Two Worlds.
Chapter 7 - Patched collision gaps along The Theta Splice and Theuthos Tunnels that allowed skipping boundaries.
Chapter 7 - Fixed softlock occurring when both players meet up after handing in their Abilities in The Fate of Two Worlds.
Chapter 7 - Fixed announcer voice triggers in The Fate of Two Worlds and resolved trap door button hand clipping.
Chapter 7 - Fixed an issue where door lights indicated the door was open when an action was still required at The Fate of Two Worlds checkpoint.
Hey Explorers,

This Patch should address some of the pain points we've gathered from your feedback, this including recurring concerns around motion sickness, checkpoints, progression, and various gameplay issues. Give them a read, and rest assured the team is already hard at work for the next patch in November.
Swapping roles in the lobby can now be done for all checkpoints.
A save icon is now displayed on screen whenever a checkpoint is reached.
The issue of losing voice chat sound after using the “test microphone” option under “Audio settings” is now fixed.

We've added four new settings to help reduce motion sickness and make your experience more comfortable. Players can toggle any combination of these four at any time in the in-game menu’s settings under “Gameplay > General”.
Added an option to enable a vignette effect on the HUD.
Added an option to increase the size of the HUD reticle.
Added an option to enable a border on the HUD.
Added an option to enable HUD border anchors.
Improved movement on angled surfaces and ramps for a smoother walking experience.
The game is included in the Windows Firewall Exceptions by default for our users on Steam.
Fixed an issue that could block all interactions when switching items with frame-perfect timing while holding aim.
Improved clarity of the voice chat connection popup on the title screen. If you can't connect to Vivox, the cancel button now reads as "Continue without voice chat."
Fixed an issue that caused beta testers to encounter a black screen when loading the first checkpoint.
Added file integrity checks to prevent levels from failing to load due to corrupted files. When corruption is detected, Steam will automatically initiate a file integrity verification.
Bypass option: Set FileIntegrityCheckBypass to True in We Were Here Tomorrow/We Were Here Tomorrow_Data/StreamingAssets/WeWereHereTomorrow.ini to disable these checks.
Fixed an issue that caused random meshes to disappear for some players.
Fixed an issue where the wrong completion percentage was displayed when resuming an existing save file.
Fixed an issue where the Class 1 Hoarder achievement displayed the wrong image on Xbox.
Fixed an issue where the Empty Hands inventory item could disappear at certain points in the game's progression.
Chapter 2 - Fixed a bug where standing too close to the microwave can trigger the enlarging sequence for that player.
Chapter 3 - You can now perform crouch slides over magnetic ramps.
Chapter 3 - Fixed headbob issues in the particle accelerator area.
Chapter 3 - Added an extra checkpoint at the laser puzzle.
Chapter 3 - Now tracks progress between play sessions in the “Offices of Tomorrow” checkpoint.
Chapter 4 - Generators now reset automatically after you’ve powered one of the batteries successfully.
Chapter 4 - Improved the clarity of the generator puzzle. Generator Y07 should be the final node in the sequence, as power cannot be redirected to another generator once it is activated.
Chapter 4 - Fixed a missing collider in a shaft causing you to fall through a wall.

Chapter 7 - Fixed an issue where the eye plant could remain locked onto players indefinitely when crouching within its vision area, potentially causing softlocks in the Outpost Hub and Rooms 2, 3, and 4.
Chapter 7 - Fixed various areas where you could get stuck in plants.

items.text: Hey Explorers,
We've just released Patch 1.1.2 for We Were Here Tomorrow, bringing numerous fixes for game-breaking bugs, softlocks, crashes, shader issues, voice chat improvements, and more!
Fixed an issue where players would get stuck in a black screen while loading checkpoints
Fixed an issue where parts of the world would not load correctly (Previously Reinstalling the game would solve this)
Fixed an issue where the voice chat would not work or reconnect if the Vivox servers went offline.
Fixed an issue where your walkie talkie would take a break and disappear sometimes
Fixed an issue where inventory items getting were blocked forever when emoting or interacting with something
Improved the shader compilation at the start to be quicker and lighter (no new warmup needed for this patch)
Added DX11 as launch option to expand compatibility
Chapter 1 - Fixed an issue where dying in the arctic would result in wrong character visuals being active
Chapter 1 - Fixed an issue where the double doors would not open when playing with high latency
Chapter 2 - Made it easier to place the battery pickup in the pull bar slot
Chapters 2 & 4 - Fixed the two pull bars door not opening when playing with high latency
Chapter 2 - Fixed an issue in Daphne’s Lab where fuses could disappear when the puzzle failed
Chapter 3 - Fixed the character getting jittery and stuck when walking on the red magnetic spiral floor
Chapter 4 - Added respawn points in the two elevators towards the server room puzzle
Chapter 4 - Improved the data tape pick up flow where players would walk to the elevator without picking it up
Chapter 5 - Fixed a soft lock where hook players could quick zip through vents reaching areas only meant for the goop block player
Chapter 5 - Fixed a hole in the floor where you could fall down, get stuck and be blinded by the bright white light
Chapter 5 - Fixed an issue where planting the wrong plant with the correct colors in the final plant pot would break the puzzle
Chapter 7 - Fixed the push block with ears getting stuck while you could still interact with it
Chapter 7 - Fixed an issue where players could get stuck in the push block with ears while interacting
Chapter 7 - Fixed the push block with ears visuals where it would not dance when it should
Chapter 7 - Fixed players getting locked in a previously visited test room door.
Changelog version 0.9.1
Added DX11 Safe mode launch option on Steam (AMD crash)
Disabled VSync by default (AMD crash)
Removed MSAA options (AMD crash)
Compressed the graphics settings so that we can create specific shader prewarm collections (Lag spikes during gameplay)
Fixed how shader prewarm collections are recorded (Lag spikes during gameplay)
Created new shader prewarm collections for all graphics presets (Lag spikes during gameplay)
Fixed first time booting game flow not triggering when the player had played other WWH titles before
Fixed first time booting game automatic quality not falling back to Very Low if quality score was too low
Fixed first time booting game brightness was 100 instead of 50
Fixed several other minor issues.
Water can go black if you toggle settings a bunch of times
